content: Tiallaichu, Pathian chongkachoi ngai diangnga inphut amun angjet khat-um alam angjet-ah Pathian in nipi-nipu ngaidiang aleiril,

takkha hiwa ajuohekna nikhuoni ngai hinchu Asapa diangnga inphut eini na-inbiak puijei. Pathian in Asapa diangnga inphut nuoipilchung hi abool, halli ahekna-ah Pathian in ikadang ama kha angrakip mapu amin ejei.

Ama'n Pathian poina ra-ang kha ejei, halli Pathian tak omchan rathuul kha ama ejei, ama ranak neina chong khan manmasituol pumpui mahuumma aleida. Miring rakip manu ngai ngaidamna apesuoli, Ranak Kaneikhet Pathian changtiang marwaan khan ama in-ongjei.
Sapa kha marwaan tirton ngai neek-ah aminlok, halli Pathian in inmani ngai diangnga ipe raming neek-ah kalok kha amadiang apejei.
Ajarchu Pathian in ama marwaan tirton ngai inkhattak diang-um,

content.text: “Nang Kasapa na-eii;
awini kei Napa ka-ejei.” leitimak.

content: Emakli Pathian in marwaan tirton inkhattak diang,

content.text: “Kei ama Pa ka-esik eii,
halli ama Kasapa esik eii,” timak. Minpkla 2:7; 2 Sam 7:14; 1 Khang 17:13

content: Takkha Pathian in Asapa salutir kha nuoipilchungnga ajuotir siktiang, ama'n ati,

content.text: “Pathian marwaan tirton rakip in ama kha chubei inthosik eii.” Innidan 32:43

content: Takkha Pathian in marwaan tirton ngai jarra hintia aril,

content.text: “Pathian in ama marwaan tirton ngaikha ratha ngai amin-eii,
khat-um ama suok ngaikha meimachuon amin-eii.” Minpkla 104:4

content: Takkha Pathian in Sapa jarra hintia aril:

content.text: “Narengram kha, E Pathian, hektik-kaboi esik eii!
Nang in nami ngai chungnga katuunna wai naroonsik eii. Minpkla 45:6,7
Nang in katuun kha namanuom halli katuunmak kha namatir.
Khawajarra Pathian, Napathian in nang kha anakadangjei
halli nasap ngai diangnga ipekha neek-ah
kheella kayana kalok kahoi kha nangdiang anapejei.”
“Pumi, nang in, inphutna-ah nuoipil nabool,
halli nakuttak in marwaan ngaikha nabool. Minpkla 102:25-27
Inmani rakip lamangsik eii, takkha nangchu mangnutin jei;
inmani rakip kha puondiar ngai angnga amaruosik eii.
Nang in inmani kha songkol inchuol angnga nathepsik eii,
halli inmani kha puondiar angnga inthuulsik eii.
Takkha nang chu pha rakip-ah inthuul makche,
halli naringkhuo um angtikniteii heknuni.”

content: Pathian in ama marwaan tirton ngai inkhattak diang:

content.text: “Kei'n nangni inhalpui ngaikha nakeii nuoiya
naketouna kamin emak laiseng,
kachangtiang hin in-ongro” leitimak. Minpkla 110:1

content: Hanle, marwaan tirton ngai ang in-eme? Inmani ngaihi Pathian sepa katho halli sanminringna kamusik ngai kasansik ah ama'n ijuotir ratha ngaikha in-eii.
